entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 0.739 +/- 0.019 solar radii from Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 757, 112, Table 6, GJ 570A: radius in solar radii, 0.739 +/- 0.019, from the literature measurement the table lists (https://doi.org/10.1088/0004-637X/757/2/112). Mass 0.743 solar masses from Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 757, 112, Table 6, GJ 570A: mass 0.743 solar masses from the K-band mass-luminosity relation of Henry & McCarthy (1993), not a dynamical mass (https://doi.org/10.1088/0004-637X/757/2/112). Temperature 4507 +/- 58 K from Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 757, 112, Table 6, GJ 570A: effective temperature in K, 4507 +/- 58, from the literature measurement the table lists.

entries.subject: Color
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at 4,507 K, because no archive holds a spectrum of this star (stis-ngsl: HD 131977 is not in the library; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: HR 5568 is not in the catalogue; kiehling: HR 5568 is not among its 60 stars; kharitonov: HR 5568 is not in the catalogue; burnashev: BS 5568 is not in part2), through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #ffdebc. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: HD 131977 is not in the library; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: HR 5568 is not in the catalogue; kiehling: HR 5568 is not among its 60 stars; kharitonov: HR 5568 is not in the catalogue; burnashev: BS 5568 is not in part2; planck: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 4,507 K and log g 4.57 (u1 0.779, u2 0.016): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
